# `fluxsim apply`

Re-execute a recorded plan and write every run artifact: the population, the events, the emit streams and their seam attestations, the run digest and the receipt. Refuses when the plan or the bundle has moved since the plan was recorded.

## Synopsis

```text
fluxsim apply [options] <bundle>
```

## Examples

```bash
# apply the plan recorded under that id (`plan` prints it)
fluxsim apply ./bundle --run-id de72fa4b22711c52
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `bundle` | path to the FLUX bundle directory |

## Options

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--run-id` | `RUN_ID` | the run id to act on (as reported by `fluxsim plan`/`fluxsim run`) (default: take a fresh plan first) |
| `--simulation-id` | `SIMULATION_ID` | which Simulation document to resolve (default: the bundle's only one) |
| `--zone` | `ZONE` | declared run zone, for sovereignty checks |
| `--state-dir` | `STATE_DIR` | run-state directory (default: ./.flux) |
| `-j, --json` |  | emit machine-readable JSON |
